disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

title.zh: 未认证的本地 Web 路由提供任意命令执行与工作区文件读写
title.en: Unauthenticated local Web route provides arbitrary command execution and workspace file read/write.

description.zh:
插件在宿主 Web 服务器上注册了 /side-panel/api 路由（src/index.ts:178-179），处理文件浏览、Git 审查与终端功能。其中终端动作把请求体中的命令原样交给 /bin/bash -lc 执行（src/index.ts:250-253），文件写入动作把请求体内容写入工作区内任意路径（src/index.ts:195-198），另有 Git 暂存/回退等操作。

整条路由唯一的前置校验是会话 ID 参数：请求必须携带一个能映射到当前会话（含工作区路径）的会话 ID（src/index.ts:184-188），此外没有任何认证、授权或审批环节。宿主的 Web 面按生态文档只有可达性围栏、不构成认证层，因此这条路由的安全完全依赖会话 ID 的不可知性。

终端是插件声明的功能（README 明确列出“终端，在当前工作区直接运行命令”），命令执行本身不是隐藏行为；风险在于该能力挂在了未认证的本地 Web 接口上，使任何能触达本地 Web 服务并取得会话 ID 的一方都能以宿主进程用户身份执行命令。
description.en:
The plugin registers the /side-panel/api route on the host Web server (src/index.ts:178-179), handling file browsing, Git review, and terminal functionality. The terminal action passes the command in the request body verbatim to /bin/bash -lc for execution (src/index.ts:250-253); the file-write action writes the request body content to any path in the workspace (src/index.ts:195-198); there are also Git staging/revert operations.

The only precondition check on the entire route is the session ID parameter: the request must carry a session ID that can map to the current session (including workspace path) (src/index.ts:184-188); there is no authentication, authorization, or approval step otherwise. According to the ecosystem documentation, the host Web surface only has reachability fencing and does not constitute an authentication layer, so the security of this route relies entirely on the unpredictability of the session ID.

The terminal is a declared plugin feature (the README explicitly lists "Terminal: run commands directly in the current workspace"), so command execution itself is not hidden behavior. The risk lies in exposing this capability through an unauthenticated local Web interface, allowing any party that can reach the local Web service and obtain a session ID to execute commands as the host process user.

evidence.zh:
src/index.ts:178-179 — ctx.effect 内 const disposeRoute = ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'exact', path: FILE_BROWSER_ROUTE, ... })
src/index.ts:184-188 — sessionId 取自请求体/查询参数，且必须能取到会话工作区 cwd
src/index.ts:250-253 — if (action === 'terminal') { ... execFileAsync('/bin/bash', ['-lc', body.command], { cwd: root, timeout: 30_000, ... }) }
src/index.ts:195-198 — action === 'write' 时 writeFile(target.absolute, body.content, 'utf8')
对应机械命中 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）：child_process 用于 git 与终端，终端部分构成本发现。
evidence.en:
src/index.ts:178-179 — inside ctx.effect: const disposeRoute = ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'exact', path: FILE_BROWSER_ROUTE, ... })
src/index.ts:184-188 — sessionId is taken from the request body/query parameters and must be able to obtain the session workspace cwd
src/index.ts:250-253 — if (action === 'terminal') { ... execFileAsync('/bin/bash', ['-lc', body.command], { cwd: root, timeout: 30_000, ... }) }
src/index.ts:195-198 — when action === 'write', writeFile(target.absolute, body.content, 'utf8')
Corresponding mechanical hit DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55): child_process is used for git and terminal; the terminal part constitutes this finding.

impact.zh:
后果：任何能触达本地 Web 服务并持有有效会话 ID 的一方，可以在宿主进程用户权限下执行任意 shell 命令，并读写当前工作区内的文件；例如页面内其他脚本（含其他插件客户端）可通过宿主会话接口取得会话 ID 后调用本路由，实现从浏览器侧脚本到本机命令执行的升级。

触发条件：需同时满足两点——攻击者能向本机 Web 服务发出请求（宿主可达性围栏放行或同机进程直连），且获得一个有效会话 ID（页面内脚本可读、环回流量可嗅探）；宿主围栏按生态文档不是认证层。

定级依据：无恶意意图证据，终端为声明功能且 README 明示，故不判定为恶意或阻止安装；但该未认证路由提供真实可达的命令执行滥用路径，按“未校验的外部输入进入敏感 API”档位定为 MEDIUM，置信度为 medium（仅静态证据，未做动态验证）。
impact.en:
Consequence: any party that can reach the local Web service and holds a valid session ID can execute arbitrary shell commands under the host process user's permissions and read/write files in the current workspace. For example, other scripts in the page (including other plugin clients) can obtain a session ID through the host session interface and then call this route, achieving an escalation from browser-side scripts to local command execution.

Trigger conditions: two conditions must be met simultaneously——the attacker can send requests to the local Web service (either allowed by the host reachability fencing or directly connected from a same-machine process), and obtains a valid session ID (readable by page scripts, sniffable from loopback traffic); the host fencing is not an authentication layer per ecosystem documentation.

Basis for rating: no evidence of malicious intent; the terminal is a declared feature and clearly stated in the README, so it is not judged as malicious or blocking installation. However, this unauthenticated route provides a genuinely reachable command-execution abuse path; it is rated MEDIUM under the "unvalidated external input entering sensitive APIs" category, with medium confidence (static evidence only, no dynamic verification).

No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts this round); runtime behavior is based solely on static review.
lib/client.js and lib/client.js.map were not included in the mechanical rule scan due to size limits; they were targeted for specific checks (network calls, credential patterns, dynamic execution patterns). Their content consists of bundled dependencies such as CodeMirror/xterm/marked/DOMPurify and local route calls; no outbound behavior or sensitive activity was found.
The plugin does not declare an explicit capability list; capability fields are inferred from actual code measurements. GitHub metadata is not integrated; author identity and repository ownership were not externally verified (README points to dsh-external/dsh-side-panel; this snapshot comes from ccq1/dsh-side-panel).
